pr_body:
This PR is implementing the indexer edition 2024, largely inspired by [the ideas from this blog post](https://blog.kerollmops.com/meilisearch-is-too-slow).

Fixes https://github.com/meilisearch/meilisearch/issues/4985

## Features
- Stream-first approach to reading documents.
- Minimum disk write operations.
- RAM usage-first approach to avoid modifying common bitmaps on disk but in memory.
- Reduced LMDB fragmentation by writing entries only once...
- ...computing the final version of the entries in parallel...
- ...and storing them in write-optimized data structures before sending them to the BTree (LMDB).
- Indexing in multiple transactions to improve large dataset support (dumps).

issue_context.title: Indexer 2024 edition: Refactor Document indexing pipeline
issue_context.body:
Refactor Document indexing pipeline.

Related to tracking issue: https://github.com/meilisearch/meilisearch/issues/4986

Related Pull Request: https://github.com/meilisearch/meilisearch/pull/4900

## Database to write
### Main
- [x] The field ids map must be exhaustive when processing settings (f502c2e543292c7bcf437b25076428c226ec6bb6)
  - [x] Possible solution: parse subfields in searchable and add them to the field id map
- [x] Remove new logs on the stderr/stdout
- [x] Fix word pair proximity performance regression (test `error_document_field_limit_reached_over_multiple_documents `)
- [x] Add a `must_stop_processing` on:
  - [x] The `DocumentOperation::into_changes`.
  - [x] In between merge operations.
- [x] documents-ids
- [x] hidden-faceted-fields, based on:
  - [x] filterable-fields
  - [x] sortable-fields
  - [x] distinct-field-key
- [x] fields-distribution
- [x] fields-ids-map
- [x] fieldids-weights-map
- [x] geo-faceted-documents-ids
- [x] geo-rtree
- [x] primary-key
    - [x] Support the `primaryKey` query param of the `/documents` route.
    - [x] Support fields that contain flat dots, i.e., "my.primary.key", "my.primary: { key }".
    - [x] Detect multiple corresponding nested keys.
    - [x] basic support
    - [x] `/documents`route should not modify a set primary key (stay consistent with the old behavior)
- [x] searchable-fields
  - [x] based on user-defined-searchable-fields
- [x] words-fst
- [x] words-prefixes-fst
- [x] updated-at
- [x] embedding_configs: the user provided bitmap is correctly rewritten in the pipeline

### Dedicated databases
#### Searchable

- [x] word-docids, based on:
  - [x] user-defined-searchable-fields
  - [x] tokenizer settings (stop-words, separators, dictionary)
  - [x] localized_attributes_rules
- [x] exact-word-docids, based on:
  - [x] exact-attributes
  - [x] user-defined-searchable-fields
  - [x] tokenizer settings (stop-words, separators, dictionary)
  - [x] localized_attributes_rules
- [x] word-pair-proximity-docids, based on:
  - [x] user-defined-searchable-fields
  - [x] tokenizer settings (stop-words, separators, dictionary)
  - [x] localized_attributes_rules
  - [x] proximity-precision
- [x] word-position-docids, based on:
  - [x] user-defined-searchable-fields
  - [x] tokenizer settings (stop-words, separators, dictionary)
  - [x] localized_attributes_rules
- [x] word-field-id-docids, based on:
  - [x] user-defined-searchable-fields
  - [x] tokenizer settings (stop-words, separators, dictionary)
  - [x] localized_attributes_rules
- [x] field-id-word-count-docids, based on:
  - [x] user-defined-searchable-fields
  - [x] tokenizer settings (stop-words, separators, dictionary)
  - [x] localized_attributes_rules

#### Prefix
- [x] word-prefix-position-docids
- [x] word-prefix-field-id-docids
- [x] word-prefix-docids
- [x] exact-word-prefix-docids

#### Faceted
- [x] facet-id-f64-docids
- [x] facet-id-exists-docids
- [x] facet-id-is-null-docids
- [x] facet-id-is-empty-docids
- [x] facet-id-string-docids
- [x] facet-id-normalized-string-strings #5019
- [x] facet-id-string-fst #5019
- [x] field-id-docid-facet-f64s
- [x] field-id-docid-facet-strings

All, based on:
  - filterable-fields
  - sortable-fields
  - distinct-field-key

#### Others
- [x] documents
- [x] external-documents-ids
- [x] vector-embedder-category-id: not applicable, this DB is not written to by the document operation, only read from
- [x] vector-arroy

## Other technical must haves

### Side pipeline support
- [x] Document deletion: connected in batch, no related failing test
- [ ] Dump: declared out-of-scope for v1.12
- [x] Support Rhai functions: partial support, check `context` object

### Error handling and resource usage
- [x] Plug the rayon `ThreadPool` back.
- [x] Use the rayon `ThreadPool` at the beginning of the whole indexing process (default pool).
- [x] Control the memory consumption (mostly around LruCache x Sorters).
- [x] Restrict memory usage with `MEILI_MAX_INDEXING_MEMORY`
- [x] Restrict CPU usage with `MEILI_MAX_INDEXING_THREADS`
- [x] Cancel indexing must work

### Dead code cleaning
- [ ] Remove useless `Transform` methods 
  - [ ] `read_documents`
  - [x] `remove_documents`
  - [x] `remove_documents_from_db_no_batch`
  - [x] `remove_document_from_db`
  - [ ] `output_from_sorter`

### Add more stats and measures
- [ ] About word size e.g., avg, mean, max, min, percentiles.
- [ ] 35% of prefixes are numbers (at least 500 words starting with numbers).
- [ ] Measure the contensions of the different channels.

### During Prelease

See https://github.com/meilisearch/meilisearch/issues/5078
   
## Validation
- [x] All the tests are green
- [ ] All Benchmarks are green
- [ ] The new indexer has been tested on cloud machines
- [ ] The memory usage is maintained under a defined threshold
- [ ] The pressure on the temporary folder must be reduced
